authority: public transfer diagnostic only; never pool with PMLAB and never use as confirmatory evidence

adapter.record_id: runtime-only opaque sequential identifier assigned in source haystack order
adapter.title: empty string
adapter.body: turns in source order, serialized as role + ': ' + content and separated by newline

backends.B1: unchanged ripgrep tokenization, IDF-like scoring, and tie break from lexical-v0
backends.B2: unchanged SQLite FTS5 unicode61 OR-query, BM25 ranking, and tie break from lexical-v0
backends.O: answerable-only scorer control returning required sessions; empty on abstention

retrieval_contract.answerable_gold: answer_session_ids mapped to runtime opaque identifiers
retrieval_contract.abstention_rule: report candidate-null and near-miss retrieval separately; neither is called correct answer abstention without a reader/completeness controller
retrieval_contract.source_content_persistence: never write questions, answers, conversations, raw source session ids, or evidence labels to tracked outputs
retrieval_contract.backend_error: record an empty result for the affected case; transfer is inconclusive if any B1/B2 error occurs

primary_outcome.metric: macro Recall@5 over six answerable question types
primary_outcome.comparison: B2 minus B1 paired difference over the 30 answerable questions
primary_outcome.stratum_aggregation: mean evidence-session recall within each question type, then equal-weight mean across six types
primary_outcome.uncertainty: 10000 paired stratified bootstrap resamples within question type

secondary_metrics: micro and macro Recall@1 and Recall@5
candidate-null rate on six abstention cases
near-miss-session intrusion at 1 and 5 on abstention cases
index bytes, build time, and query latency

sanity_controls.B0: zero recall and no returned candidates
sanity_controls.O: Recall@5 and all-required-at-5 equal 1.0 on answerable cases and no returned candidates on abstention
sanity_controls.determinism: B1 and B2 rankings must be byte-identical across two fresh processes

interpretation_rule.supports_sparse_transfer: B2-B1 point difference is positive, the 95% lower bound is at least zero, no question type loses more than 0.10 Recall@5, all controls pass, and there are no backend errors
interpretation_rule.fails_sparse_transfer: B2-B1 point difference is non-positive or any question type loses more than 0.10 Recall@5, with otherwise valid controls
interpretation_rule.inconclusive: bootstrap interval crosses zero despite a positive point estimate, any control fails, any B1/B2 backend error occurs, source/version drift occurs, or rankings are non-deterministic
interpretation_rule.architecture_effect: none; the bridge can support or fail external transfer of the sparse baseline only

execution_sequence: verify source bytes, source hash, selection hash, and PMLAB receipts
freeze and commit this adapter and interpretation contract
implement and test the runner without inspecting backend outcomes
repeat rankings in two fresh processes for determinism
publish only content-free per-case metrics and aggregate results
